correctness.rationale: The exact legal triple predicate for 0/top/bottom/both is necessary and sufficient for maximum induced degree <=1. Trace of the 16-state two-column transfer counts every cyclic word, with det(I-tT)=Q(t,z). I independently reconstructed the full polynomial determinant using symbolic linear algebra and obtained exactly the two factors claimed; direct binary-subset enumeration for n=3,...,7 agreed coefficient-by-coefficient. The successor-empty injection shows #double <= #empty, hence size <=n; equality requires either an alternating double/empty cyclic word (two when n even) or a binary singleton cyclic word avoiding 000 and 111. The latter four-state transfer has eigenvalues of (lambda²-lambda-1)(lambda²+lambda+1), giving L_n + (2 if 3|n else -1). Complements are exactly minimum P3-vertex covers. The proof covers every n>=3; bounded experiments are regression only.
